en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing the ruins of a medieval hilltop castle complex above a river valley and patchwork fields. The foreground features massive stone walls and a partly collapsed gabled structure with arched window openings, while a round tower and additional ruined walls stand further back. In the distant background, a rural landscape with fields and scattered buildings is visible. German printed text appears along the bottom margin.
